name: breakhis-supervised-resnet50-v1
batch_norm: pretrained running statistics fixed; affine parameters train after warmup
draws_per_epoch: number of fitting fields, weighted replacement
sampler: equal class, equal case within class, equal magnification, uniform field within view
augmentation: draw/epoch/path/seed deterministic H/V flips, quarter rotations, brightness/contrast/saturation factors [0.9,1.1] in fixed order
canonical_transform: whole field RGB resized bicubic 224x224, ImageNet mean/std; no crop or fitted preprocessing
case_readout: mean field probabilities per view, equal mean of available views
selection: maximum validation mean macroF1 over all15subsets, earliest tie
